intents.answer: Hi! I can help you find info about ICUE’s services, projects, recruitment, policies, and contact details. What are you looking for?

ICUE provides consulting related to planning/design, project management, procedure support, and sustainability-focused solutions. Tell me your project type + scope (design, supervision, documentation, etc.) and I’ll point you to the best next step.

Yes — we can support planning and design depending on the project needs. If you share the site/location, goals, and current status (idea / concept / detailed design), I can suggest the most suitable workflow.
We can provide project management and coordination support depending on scope. If you tell me timeline, stakeholders, and deliverables, I can outline a practical PM plan.
Supervision/monitoring support depends on project type and location. Share the project location and phase (design / tender / construction) and I’ll advise the best approach.
We can assist with procedures/document preparation depending on the project. If you tell me your city/province and project type, I can suggest what documents are typically needed and the usual steps.

Common starting documents include: basic site info, goals/scope, existing drawings (if any), and relevant legal/ownership papers (if applicable). If you share what you already have, I can tell you what’s missing.
Fees vary by scope, timeline, and project complexity. If you share a 3–5 line brief (project type, location, size, timeline, and what you need), we can provide a more accurate estimate.
Payment terms are usually aligned with milestones (e.g., concept → draft → final). If you share your timeline and deliverables, we can suggest a reasonable milestone plan.

Typical flow: initial discussion → collect requirements → site/context review → draft deliverables → revisions → final delivery. If you tell me your project stage, I can recommend the right starting point.
Timeline depends on scope and approvals. Share your deadline and what you need delivered (concept only vs. full package) and I’ll suggest a realistic timeline and checkpoints.
We can use BIM/3D modeling where appropriate to help visualize and coordinate design. Tell me your deliverable needs (3D model, views, coordination) and I’ll advise.
Yes — we can incorporate sustainability goals (materials, energy, climate resilience) depending on project context. Share your priorities and constraints and I’ll propose practical options.
We work with a mix of individuals, organizations/businesses, and public-sector stakeholders depending on the program/project. If you share your context, I can point to similar examples.
If you tell me the project location (city/province) and whether you prefer remote or on-site support, I can advise what’s feasible and the typical workflow.
You can browse projects and activities under Work / Past Projects. If you tell me your domain (urban, environment, community…), I’ll suggest the closest examples.
You can check the News page for recent updates and articles.
ICUE also runs/participates in community activities and programs. Check the Community Activities page for more.
Check the Recruitment page for open roles and requirements. If you share the role you’re targeting, I can help you tailor your CV and application message.
If you’re looking for internships, the Recruitment page is the best place to start. Share your background + interests and I can suggest what to highlight in your application.
We’re open to collaboration depending on alignment and scope. If you share who you are, the topic, and what you’re proposing, I can help draft a clear outreach message.
For media/press requests, please contact us with your deadline, topic, and what you need (quote/interview/speaker). I can help you draft the request message.
Sure — share your preferred time window, timezone, and what you want to discuss. If you message via the Contact page, include these details to speed things up.
Yes — if you share a brief scope (goals, deliverables, timeline, budget range if available), we can respond with a proposal structure and next steps.
You can review our policy pages (Privacy, GDPR, Terms, Cookies). Tell me which one you need and I’ll point you there.
You can use the FAQs page for quick answers — and feel free to ask here too. I’ll try to find the closest match from the FAQ knowledge base.
